about: Berättelser efter striden (Listen to the story). Byggs av prototypes/story-listen/export.py, ändra inte för hand.

stories.title: The camel at the oasis
lines: The {sun} is up, and the {camel} walks to the {water}.
It finds a {cup} by a {tree}.
There is no {milk} in the cup, only {juice}.
So the camel eats some {bread} and a {banana}.
In the evening, the camel and its friend {watch TV|watch_tv} in the {house}.

stories.title: Breakfast at the oasis
lines: One morning, you eat {breakfast} by the {water}.
There is {bread}, an {egg}, a {banana}, and a {cup} of {milk}.
Then a {camel} comes, and it eats your banana!
You are {sad}, but the camel has some {juice} for you.
Now you are {happy}, and the camel is happy too.

stories.title: The caravan stops
lines: It is a {hot} day in the desert.
The caravan stops, and the camels sit by the {water}.
The children {play football|play_football} in the sand.
Then everyone eats {cake}, and the {juice} is nice and {cold}.
The {camel} eats an {orange}.

stories.title: The camel's lunch
lines: It is lunch time for the {camel}.
It eats a {carrot} and an {orange}.
But it does not eat the {cheese}.
The cheese sits in the {sun} all day, and now it is {hot}!
Then a {mouse} comes and eats it all.

stories.title: The wind takes your hat
lines: You walk up a big sand dune in a {hat}.
The hat is {new}, but the wind takes it, and it flies away!
You {run} after it, and you lose a {shoe} and a {sock}.
At the top, you find an {old} hat, but it is not your hat.
So you take a {T-shirt|shirt} from your {bag} and put it on your head, because the {sun} is hot.

stories.title: The fox and the old shoe
lines: The {fox} finds an {old shoe|old_shoe} in the sand.
"This is my {hat}, and it is {new}!" says the fox.
It puts the shoe on its head and walks to the {camel}.
The camel laughs. "That is not a hat. It is a {shoe}!"
So the camel gives the fox a real {hat} from its {bag}.

stories.title: Shopping with coins
lines: Today you go to the market with {six} coins.
You want a {pizza}, an {ice cream|ice_cream}, and a {cookie}.
The pizza costs {five} coins, so you buy it.
Now you have one {coin}. That is not enough for the ice cream.
But the man at the market gives you a {cookie} for free!

stories.title: The bear at the market
lines: A {bear} comes to the market with {seven} coins.
"I want a {tomato}," says the bear.
But then it sees the {ice cream|ice_cream}, and it wants that too.
The bear buys a tomato and an ice cream, and it is very {happy}.
At home, the bear and its friend {play video games|play_video_games}.

stories.title: Night at the camp
lines: It is night at the camp, and the {moon} is up.
The {clock} says it is time to {sleep}.
You go into your {tent}.
But a {cat} is {in} your {bed}!
So you sleep on a {chair}, and you dream that you {go skiing|go_skiing}.

stories.title: Where is my chair?
lines: "Where is my {chair}?" says the {camel}.
It is not {in} the {tent}.
It is not by the {bed}, and it is not by the {clock}.
The camel looks {in} its {bag}, but a chair is too big for a bag!
Then the camel goes out, and there is the chair. A {bear} sits on it in the {sun}!

stories.title: Picnic by the cactus
lines: You sit by a big {cactus}, and you are very {hungry}.
You have a {plate}, a {spoon}, and a {knife}.
But there is no food! You forgot it at home.
You are {thirsty} too, and there is no {water}.
Then a {camel} comes with {bread}, some {cheese}, and some {juice}.

stories.title: The money in the cactus
lines: The {camel} has some {money} in a {bag}.
It walks by a {cactus}, and the bag gets a hole.
The money falls out, and the camel does not see it.
Now the camel is {hungry}, but it cannot buy {bread}.
Then a {mouse} brings back the money on a {plate}!

stories.title: The ball in the ruin
lines: You kick a {ball}, and it goes into an {old} ruin.
You open the {door} and look for it.
Is the ball {under} the {box}? No.
Is it {on} the {book}? No.
It is {under} the {window}, next to a {cat}!

stories.title: The old book
lines: In the ruin, a {book} is {on} a {box}.
It is very {old}.
A {key} is {under} the book.
The key opens the {door}, and you go in.
In the room, there is a big {window} and a red {ball}.

stories.title: Counting at the gate
lines: At the Sun Gate, there are {eight} cars and {nine} boats.
A {lion} sits {on} a {car}.
"This is my car!" says the lion.
"No, it is my car!" says a {camel}.
So they count to {ten} and drive away in the car together.

stories.title: The lion's boat
lines: The {lion} wants to go on the water in a {boat}.
It has {ten} coins.
A {boat} costs {nine} coins, and a {car} costs {eight}.
The lion buys the boat, and it has one coin left.
"This is a good day," says the lion, and it is very {happy}.

stories.title: The Sphinx's story
lines: "Listen to my story," says the Sphinx.
A {camel} walks to the oasis and drinks {milk} from a {cup}.
At the market, it buys a {pizza} with {seven} coins.
At night, it sleeps {in} a {tent}, and the {clock} goes tick, tock.
In the morning, it finds a {ball} under a {box} in the ruin.
Then it puts on a {hat} and drives a {car} to the Sun Gate.
"Now you know my story," says the Sphinx. "Are you {happy}?"
